verified.claim: The Fraud Case PRD still documents the extract source as data/raw/DP_Fraud_Case.csv, contradicting the pipeline's actual config (config.SOURCE_DIR = data/product), even though the KT doc flags this as a known stale-prose issue elsewhere.

The 04_code README still says the extract is read from data/raw/DP_Fraud_Case.csv, but src/fraud_case/config.py reads from data/product/DP_Fraud_Case.csv; this is acknowledged as stale prose in docs/kt/fraud-case/README.md but not corrected here.

data.summary: tools/leftshift/attest.py correctly implements the make/verify/review_files behaviour required by AC-5, AC-6 and AC-7 (gate-first ordering with no model call on a red gate, a size refusal before any truncation, staging only on a verdict with no verified HIGH finding, whole-branch diffing with CSV/data/binary/vendored-gate exclusion, and a verify() that rejects missing/stale/failed/non-A2A/missing-gate/red-gate/HIGH-finding attestations), and trace.json's implements-line references for these ACs match the file; tools/leftshift/checks.py (which would implement AC-1–AC-4) is not part of this staged diff so its behaviour could not be verified. No HIGH-severity issues (PII columns or data/raw leakage) were found in the large accompanying Fraud Case/Member 360 product code, which keeps PII columns confined to the raw source contract and excludes them from published tables per its own test; only minor stale-documentation mismatches (PRD/README still citing data/raw instead of data/product) were noted.
